Reuse Domain of Practice, Grimoire resources, and the existing work-record schema; preserve one outcome owner and optional crew recruitment.

Wire routes into README, AGENTS, crew registry, and continuity guidance. No new agents, runtime, task store, source-package changes, or main merge.

Local fixture tests: 25 passed. Inherited suites and actual-checkout validation await this commit's GitHub Actions evidence.
